description: Telegram initData HMAC-SHA256 validation, Anti-detect for Playwright (stealth, proxy, fingerprint randomization), and E2E tests with mock server. Implements server-side initData validation in payments/webhook.py. Enhances freelance_automation with playwright-stealth, user-agent rotation, human-like delays, proxy support, fingerprint randomization. Creates tests/e2e/ with mock server and Playwright E2E tests.
steps: Create payments/init_data_validator.py: validate_init_data(init_data_str: str, bot_token: str) -> bool function. Implementation: parse init_data as URL-encoded params, extract 'hash' field, sort remaining params alphabetically, join with newline, compute HMAC-SHA256 using WebAppData secret key (HMAC-SHA256 of bot_token with key 'WebAppDataSecret'), compare computed hash with extracted hash. Return True if match. Follow official Telegram documentation for Web App data validation

Update payments/webhook.py _handle_update: for requests that include initData (e.g., from Mini App), validate using validate_init_data(). Add header or body field 'X-Telegram-Init-Data'. If validation fails, return 401 Unauthorized. Apply to payment-related endpoints only (not pre_checkout_query which comes from Telegram servers directly)
Update payments/mini_app.html: when sending requests to backend, include Telegram.WebApp.initData in request headers as 'X-Telegram-Init-Data'

Create freelance_automation/stealth.py: StealthConfig dataclass with proxy (optional SOCKS5/HTTP URL), user_agents list (10+ realistic desktop Chrome/Firefox UAs), min_delay/max_delay (seconds, default 1.0-3.0), enable_stealth (bool, default True). Function apply_stealth(page) that applies playwright-stealth. Function random_delay() that sleeps random seconds between min/max. Function get_random_user_agent() returning random UA from list

Update freelance_automation/base.py: add optional stealth_config: StealthConfig parameter to login() signature (backward compatible with default None). Add proxy_url and user_agent to FreelancePlatform base class as optional attributes

Update freelance_automation/kwork.py KworkPlatform: integrate stealth - on login(), if stealth config provided: launch browser with proxy, set user-agent, apply playwright-stealth to page. In fetch_new_orders and respond_to_order, add random_delay() calls between page interactions (goto, fill, click) to simulate human behavior. Randomize viewport size slightly
Update freelance_automation/flru.py FLruPlatform: same stealth integration as kwork.py - proxy, user-agent rotation, random delays between actions, playwright-stealth application
Update freelance_automation/config.py: add PROXY_URL (from env FREELANCE_PROXY_URL), STEALTH_ENABLED (from env, default True), MIN_ACTION_DELAY, MAX_ACTION_DELAY

Create tests/e2e/conftest.py: pytest fixtures for mock HTTP server (aiohttp test server simulating kwork.ru/fl.ru pages - login page, projects list with sample cards, project detail with response form). Fixture for Playwright browser instance

Create tests/e2e/mock_server.py: aiohttp app that serves mock HTML pages mimicking Kwork.ru and FL.ru project listings. Include realistic HTML structure matching the selectors used in kwork.py (.card__content, .wants-card__header-title) and flru.py (#projects-list, .b-post)

Create tests/e2e/test_kwork_login.py: test KworkPlatform can load cookies and navigate to mock Kwork server. Test fetch_new_orders returns parsed orders from mock HTML. Test respond_to_order fills form on mock server
Create tests/e2e/test_flru_login.py: test FLruPlatform can load cookies and navigate to mock FL.ru server. Test fetch_new_orders parses mock HTML correctly. Test respond_to_order works against mock

Create tests/test_init_data_validator.py: test validate_init_data with known-good test vectors (construct valid initData string, compute correct hash, verify returns True). Test tampered data returns False. Test missing hash returns False. Test empty string returns False
acceptance_criteria: payments/init_data_validator.py correctly validates Telegram initData using HMAC-SHA256
payments/webhook.py validates initData for Mini App requests and returns 401 on failure
freelance_automation/stealth.py provides stealth configuration with proxy, UA rotation, delays
kwork.py and flru.py integrate stealth (delays between actions, proxy support, playwright-stealth)
tests/e2e/ directory with mock server and E2E tests exists
verification: python -c "from payments.init_data_validator import validate_init_data; from freelance_automation.stealth import StealthConfig, apply_stealth, random_delay"
findings: Python 3.9 is the runtime in this sandbox (despite 3.11 being available). Added from __future__ import annotations to base.py, kwork.py, flru.py for PEP 604 union type syntax compatibility. playwright-stealth installed successfully. One pre-existing test failure: test_telegram_keyboard_has_5_rows (expects 5 rows but 7 exist). E2E tests are correctly marked with pytest.mark.e2e and skipif for when playwright is not available.
